title: Late report and calibration revision produce event revisions
description: The first run happens before S3's backfill and before the late calibration anchors arrive. It publishes provisional events without S3. The second run sees S3's records and a revised calibration, so events that now include S3 are published as revisions naming the events they supersede: no activity is silently split into two while the old count remains.

expected.note: second run's calibration hash for S1/S2 must differ from the first run
